name: In Recovery from Alcoholics Anonymous 's Podcast

episodes.title: Social Placebo - An Autopsy with Guest Theo
episodes.description:
This week, Theo pulls back the curtain on his time in the rooms. Theo went at AA wholeheartedly: he worked the steps thrice+ over, followed the program with incredible precision, had a sponsor, and had his own batch of sponsees. So what finally made him get out of Dodge? He traces the surprising overlap between Scientology and AA, recounts his exposure to the Freedom Model and Writing the Big Book, and breaks down other paths to sobriety like Recovery Dharma and SMART Recovery.
Drop everything and listen. Theo was all in, and now he's telling the truth about these meetings that most people won't say out loud.


Show notes at https://www.patreon.com/cw/inrecovery
